snippet.title: Sally Face 2 - Official Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist Sally Face 2 on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3937470/Sally_Face_2/

After the haunting climax of Sally Face, the sequel continues the dark adventure with a group of friends struggling to find meaning in a world broken by darkness.

Watch the Sally Face 10th Anniversary Celebration: https://youtu.be/leSw63-Oh6Q?si=RPlRUmLsYeN4rySI
